title: Transitions
summary: GPU shader transitions in the theme's look, shown going from the sample clip (under the night look) to a title card: seven of its own, where a thin line of light does the cutting (a sweeping line, an iris fired from the red dot, a sunburst, rows drawn in by a pen of light, a red-cause/blue-result cut, an echo split, a horizon that opens), and five from the shared set drawn in the theme's colours (lilac light, red and orange accents, a white core on the near-black teal room).
usage: On a shot (the transition INTO it from the shot before): {"transition": {"name": "light_wipe", "seconds": 0.8}}. In a footage storyboard, at a cut such as the start of a full-screen cutaway: "transitions": [{"name": "origin_iris", "at": 7.8, "seconds": 0.7}]. Engine: library/_shared/shader_transitions.py (moderngl); this theme's own shaders and its colours for the shared ones are in transitions/theme_transitions.py.

items.name: light wipe
items.description: One line of light sweeps down the frame with the next shot behind it: red echo trailing, blue leading, a lilac wake. The theme default.

items.name: horizon open
items.description: A horizon line draws out from the middle, then splits and the halves travel apart, opening the next shot between them.

items.name: scan draw
items.description: The next shot is drawn in row by row by a travelling point of light, top row first, like a fast pen.

items.name: origin iris
items.description: The red dot top-left fires and a ring of light opens from it across the frame, the next shot inside (red outside the ring, blue in).

items.name: ray burst
items.description: A sunburst: rays shoot out of the middle one after another and widen into lit wedges of the next shot until they meet.

items.name: red blue cut
items.description: Cause, then result: the shot burns red from the edges, cuts hard on a blue flash, and the next shot cools to itself.

items.name: echo split
items.description: The shot pulls apart into red and blue echoes and drops into the dark; the next arrives split and locks hard on its core.

items.name: scan wipe
items.description: Shared: a bright scan beam reveals the next shot with a short interlaced trail, in lilac and white.

items.name: iris glow
items.description: Shared: a circle opens from the centre with a glowing lilac rim and red ticks.

items.name: zoom through
items.description: Shared: the camera flies through the shot into the next with a radial streak.

items.name: crt collapse
items.description: Shared: the picture collapses to a white line and a point, and the next shot opens from it.

items.name: slice slide
items.description: Shared: the shot slides away in horizontal slices over the dark room, lit at the rims.
